items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: His name was Chris (PHONETIC) or C-r -- C-h-r -- h-i-r-t-c-h. Chris Hartch 's Brewery.

ctx.x: His name was Chris (PHONETIC) or C-r -- C-h-r -- h-i-r-t-c-h. Chris Hartch 's Brewery. I think the beer still is on the market in Washington, D.C. at the present time. And so in this kindergarten, we were learning German.

Because we were playing in German and when we go to school we'd be in English because in Foggy Bottom, everyone was down there and you had the Potomac Indian down there and you had the -- well, you had Italian, you had the underclass white man, because he was poor, and you had -- see, you have some Arabs down there, too. So all right, going to school and then the kindergarten and then they gave us a little job of pasting the label on the bottles, on the (inaudible), and they used to give us a sandwich called…
